The brownfield review for run `20261104-005757-feature-new-home-unread-notifications-card` is complete and written to [review.json](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261104-005757-feature-new-home-unread-notifications-card/review.json).

### Summary of Checks
- **Correctness**: [`CardExtension`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx#L127-L145) falls back to `DefaultProgress` outside an `AppContext`; [`Content`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.tsx#L63-L175) in `HomePageUnreadNotifications` fetches unread notifications, handles live signals and polling fallback with unmount cleanup, marks items as read, and links to `?id=<id>`; [`NotificationsPage`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsPage/NotificationsPage.tsx#L84-L85) and [`NotificationsTable`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsTable/NotificationsTable.tsx#L83-L88) highlight matching notification rows; legacy and alpha plugin exports, API/knip reports, changesets, and docs match [change_plan.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261104-005757-feature-new-home-unread-notifications-card/change_plan.md).
- **Type safety**: Explicit `@public` and `@alpha` TSDoc tags, narrowed types, and zero `tsc` or API report errors.
- **Error handling**: Fetch errors render `ResponseErrorPanel`, failed mark-as-read actions roll back optimistic state and post a danger toast, and missing `AppContext` in `CardExtension` is caught cleanly.
- **Test coverage**: [extensions.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx) and [HomePageUnreadNotifications.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.test.tsx) cover happy paths, empty/error states, mark-as-read, live signals, polling fallback + timer cleanup, and deep-link row highlighting using accessible queries.
